The Care Problems Checklist

What to write down, who to ask and what to keep open before the next family call.

Download PDF

Your father's care isn't working, and every phone call about it tries to cover ten problems at once. Before the family talks again, work through these. Check what you've done. Anything unchecked is a job for this week, not a verdict on anyone.

Write down

Ask

Keep open

What this checklist doesn't do

It helps you write things down, ask the people who know, and keep track of what's still open. It doesn't say what a checked or unchecked box means, whose fault anything is, or what your father needs. That's for the people who assess him, and for the next step below.

Ready for the next step?

You've written down the concerns, asked the people who know, and put the rest on an open list. The care interview goes through your father's situation area by area, including the parts nobody has raised yet, and turns your answers into a Family Care Profile you can bring to any care conversation.

Create Your Free Family Care Profile ›

Where this comes from

Items marked 1 follow the Family Caregiver Alliance's guide to holding a family meeting, which suggests asking what support the primary caregiver needs, keeping a written summary of what each person agreed to, and planning on more than one meeting. The rest come from the Family Care Roadmap's own working list for this step.
